results.title: Quantum Computing, Communication, and Simulation VI
results.content: Migdall, Joint Quantum Institute (United States) High-precision time-correlated single-photon counting (TCSPC), single-photon and entangled-photon generation, quantum communication, and ultrafast quantum optics demand laser sources that deliver both short pulses and exceptional timing stability. We present the performance and application potential of Menhir Photonics' low-noise femtosecond and picosecond laser system, which combines sub-10 fs timing jitter and repetition rates up to 10 GHz. Operating at telecom-compatible wavelengths (1535 or 1553 nm), this type of lasers are already in used as a compelling solution for scalable and field-deployable quantum technologies. Burenkov, National Institute of Standards and Technology (United States), Joint Quantum Institute (United States); Sergey V. Polyakov, National Institute of Standards and Technology (United States), Univ. Path-entangled single-photon states are an attractive resource for entanglement distribution on quantum networks. Quantum information processing and communication protocols based on time-bin entangled photonic qudits Here, we present two frameworks enabling the generation and manipulation of time-bin entangled photonic qudits for both fundamental and applied quantum information processing.
